STAGE: one new ideation candidate for the SID/behaviour/hyperbolic coupling round.
GOAL: propose a mechanism distinct from the six earlier rejected ones and from other agents, changing what Stage-2 optimises rather than relabelling SIDs or re-metricking fixed codes.
READ: round objective, scope contract, experiment policy, and the earlier rounds list (Poincare-Frechet successor codebook, CURVCTRL-SID level curvature, BRad-RQ radial assignment, behcone-prefix-rq, LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ, TSG-SID, MIXCURV-FIBRE-RQ). Baseline probe to beat: Spearman 0.0402, top-10 overlap 0.0124.
OBSERVED: every earlier mechanism perturbed the codebook update, a per-level curvature, radial position, a cone constraint, a fibre mixture, or a graph-cut tree. None changed the item-side quantization target itself.
REASONING: the strongest untried lever is the target the quantizer is asked to encode: a per-item Lorentz geodesic barycentre between the item's own text point and the Lorentz Frechet mean of its training-split co-consumption neighbours, blended with a mass-derived weight, then quantized by a curved residual chain with trainable curvature. Behaviour sets direction and magnitude; curvature sets the geodesic and every residual after level 1; zeroing the behaviour weight or taking K to 0 changes the same tensor.
RESULT: idea LCB-RQ, fully specified in the final answer block (equations, cost at 24556 items / 24 steps per epoch / 3000 epochs, safeguards, three code switches that exist but are not trained off).
OPEN: no run performed here; the candidate must be judged by the two probe numbers before Stage-3, then Stage-3 test_recall@10 against 0.065 with the ~0.013 single-run caveat.
